apps.subtitle: Ocarina of Time for iPhone & Vision Pro
apps.localizedDescription: The Ship of Harkinian port of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, running natively on Metal — the full quest with saves, the enhancements menu, texture-pack support, and on Apple Vision Pro a stereoscopic 3D mode. versions.localizedDescription:
First public release of Ship of Harkinian (The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time) for iPhone and Apple Vision Pro — a native Metal port.

**Features**
- Full quest with saves, audio and music, and cutscenes
- The Ship of Harkinian enhancements menu (higher frame rates, widescreen, quality-of-life toggles)
- In-app ROM extraction — no PC tools needed
- Game controllers with menu-aware navigation, plus a tunable on-screen touch layout (including per-button hide/show)
- 60 / 120 Hz (ProMotion) and a supersampling slider
- Texture-pack (`.o2r`) support via drag-and-drop in Files
- **Apple Vision Pro:** a true-4K windowed mode plus a world-locked **stereoscopic 3D mode** with foveated rendering and spatial audio

**Install:** add the SideStore source and install — see the [README](https://github.com/rebelancap/Shipwright-ios#install). Bring your own Ocarina of Time ROM; no game content is included.

versions.localizedDescription:
**Quake for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro** — a native port of [vkQuake](https://github.com/Novum/vkQuake) (Vulkan via MoltenVK), including a world-locked **stereoscopic 3D mode** on Apple Vision Pro.

Ships with **no game content** — you supply your own Quake files (2021 re-release recommended; original `pak0`/`pak1` also works).

### What's new in 1.0.4

**Aim holds.** Looking up or down no longer springs back to level after a second. Touch and gyro aiming never told the engine to stop its pitch drift, so the view pulled itself back to level after every aim.

**Customizable touch layout.** *Settings → Touch Controls → Customize Touch Layout* — drag any control exactly where you want it, resize them all live with the slider, reset from the same bar. Your layout is saved per control.

The move stick is placeable too. It floats to wherever your thumb lands, so what it really has is an activation *zone* — shown in the editor as a large faint circle you can drag anywhere. That replaces the old Lefty Layout switch, which only ever offered a mirror image; if you had it on, your layout is migrated automatically.

**Quick save and quick load.** During a single-player game, open the main menu and they appear on the left under the back and gear buttons — never over the HUD, and not in submenus. Your quicksave now also shows as the **top-most entry in the Load menu**, so you can find and load it the normal way.

**Weapon wheel slow motion.** Holding the weapon wheel slows the world to a quarter speed while the game keeps its full frame rate, like the re-release. Single-player only. `vkq_wheel_timescale` in the console tunes it.

### Also in this release
- **Brightness slider** in Settings
- Every settings slider now **shows its value** — sensitivity, field of view, and the rest
- Action buttons carry **glyphs**: crosshair to fire, up arrow to jump, down arrow to crouch
- FPS counter is smaller and sits in the true top-right corner
- Fixed: settings rows that never responded to taps, including Vision Pro's **Recenter Screen**
- New default control layout, arranged on device

### Install via SideStore source (recommended — auto-updates)
Add one URL to [SideStore](https://sidestore.io) / [AltStore](https://altstore.io) and the app installs *and updates itself* when new versions ship:
- **iPhone / iPad:** `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rebelancap/quake-ports/main/apps-ios.json`
- **Apple Vision Pro:** `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rebelancap/quake-ports/main/apps-visionos.json`

These are shared sources — they also carry Quake II and Quake III. On **Apple Vision Pro**, first install SideStore onto the headset with [iloader](https://github.com/rebelancap/iloader/releases#release-visionos), then add the source in SideStore.

### Or download and sideload manually
- **`vkQuake-1.0.4-iOS.ipa`** — iPhone / iPad (iOS 16+)
- **`vkQuake-1.0.4-visionOS.ipa`** — Apple Vision Pro (visionOS 2+)

Full instructions in the [README](https://github.com/rebelancap/vkQuake-ios#readme).

versions.localizedDescription:
**Quake II for iPhone and Apple Vision Pro** — a native port of [q2repro](https://github.com/Paril/q2repro) (Q2PRO with 2023 re-release support, rendering on Metal via ANGLE), including a world-locked **stereoscopic 3D mode** on Apple Vision Pro.

Ships with **no game content** — you supply your own Quake II files (2023 re-release recommended; an original `baseq2` also works).

### New in 1.0.8 — Vision Pro 3D
- **Eye-tracked foveated rendering**, always on when the hardware supports it. The screen is rendered at full density exactly where you're looking, so 3D is noticeably sharper at no performance cost.
- **New settings: Render Resolution + Sharpening.** Render Resolution (40–100%) sets the per-eye render budget; Sharpening (contrast-adaptive, applies live) restores edge crispness. They work as a pair — the default 60% + 100% holds a locked 120 fps in play while staying crisp.
- **Smoother 3D** overall: the stereo pipeline now hands the compositor only completed frames and never re-processes an unchanged one.
- **Exiting 3D reliably restores your window.** The "window stuck tiny after leaving 3D" bug is fixed at its root cause, in every exit flow — including quitting the app while in 3D and relaunching.

### New in 1.0.8 — iPhone and Vision Pro
- On first launch the app's folder now appears in the Files app immediately (with a read-me explaining what to copy where). The app no longer pre-creates `baseq2` — dropping your own folder in no longer ends up as "baseq2 2".
- The FPS counter toggle now works in 3D and persists across launches.

versions.localizedDescription:
A big Apple Vision Pro 3D-mode upgrade, plus fixes for every platform.

## What's new in 1.0.2

### Apple Vision Pro — 3D mode
- **Dramatically sharper 3D.** The immersive panel now uses eye-tracked foveated
  rendering — resolution concentrates exactly where you look. The blur compared
  to the 2D window is gone.
- **Fixed the real world "leaking" through bright surfaces** (doors, ammo boxes,
  bullet marks, shadows) in 3D — the panel is now fully opaque.
- **Fixed one-eyed menu cursor** and the scoreboard highlight rendering
  differently per eye.
- **First-person weapon no longer pops uncomfortably close** in 3D — it now uses
  the same weapon-stereo projection desktop Quake III uses (the Vulkan renderer
  had never picked it up).
- **Brightness works in 3D** — the settings Brightness slider now adjusts the 3D
  panel live (open settings with the gear while immersive).
- **120 Hz on M5 Vision Pro.** "Native" refresh was capped at 90 Hz; it now runs
  the panel's full rate (earlier headsets remain at 90).
- **App icon now shows correctly** in SideStore / AltStore's "My Apps" list on
  visionOS.

### All devices
- **Gamepad look sensitivity fixed** — the Look sensitivity X/Y sliders now
  affect controller aim (they were touch-only), with a faster default and a
  wider 0.5–10 range.
- **In-game brightness works** — the stock SETUP menu's Brightness slider was
  disabled on iOS/visionOS; it's live now, and default brightness is brighter.
- **Settings sheet:** the Done button is pinned (no more scrolling back up),
  and Vision Pro panel measurements default to feet.

Everything from 1.0.1 is unchanged otherwise — you keep your settings and data.

## Install

**The easy way — the auto-updating source (SideStore / AltStore).** Add the shared
Quake-ports source, then install Quake III from it; future updates appear automatically:

- iPhone / iPad: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rebelancap/quake-ports/main/apps-ios.json`
- Apple Vision Pro: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rebelancap/quake-ports/main/apps-visionos.json`

On Apple Vision Pro, first install SideStore onto the headset with
[iloader](https://github.com/rebelancap/iloader/releases#release-visionos), then add the
source in SideStore. (iloader installs SideStore itself — apps are then installed and
kept refreshed by SideStore.)

**Or manually:** download the IPA below and sideload it with
[SideStore](https://sidestore.io), [AltStore](https://altstore.io), or
[Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io):

- `Quake3e-1.0.2-iOS.ipa` — iPhone / iPad (iOS 16+)
- `Quake3e-1.0.2-visionOS.ipa` — Apple Vision Pro (visionOS 2+)

**You bring the game:** copy your own `baseq3` folder (retail `pak0.pk3` from Steam,
GOG, or CD) into the app at first launch or via the Files app. Nothing copyrighted
ships in these IPAs. See the [README](https://github.com/rebelancap/quake3e-ios#readme)
for setup, controls, and FAQ.

apps.localizedDescription: Apotris — a fast, feature-packed block-stacking game — running natively on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro through Metal (no emulator). Marathon, Sprint, Ultra, Dig, Blitz, Zen and more, with gesture / GB-button / controller / keyboard input, display filters (Sharp / LCD / CRT), and the full skin and palette customization. versions.localizedDescription:
### Pick up where you left off

Leaving the app now saves your run, so a force-quit — or a reboot, or iOS
evicting the app — no longer loses a long game. **Continue** appears at the top
of the main menu on the next launch and puts you back exactly where you were:
board, active piece, hold, next queue, score, level, timer and grade progress.

Backgrounding on its own never ended a run (the game just pauses in place), so
this only kicks in when the app actually stops running.

One slot, and it's cleared once you resume — a run you carried to a game over
can't be reloaded and re-rolled onto the leaderboards.

### Also

- README: the FAQ still claimed online multiplayer wasn't in the build. It has
  been since 1.1.7 — Multi Battle, private rooms by code, up to 5 players.

---

**Install:** sideload the IPA with SideStore / AltStore (iOS) or
[iloader](https://github.com/rebelancap/iloader/releases#release-visionos)
(Apple Vision Pro). Requires iOS 17+ / visionOS 2+.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

A small follow-up to 1.1.7.

## Fixed
- **visionOS Settings** now describe the actual pinch gestures instead of the iOS touch wording. In menus, a **left-hand pinch is Back** (right-hand pinch confirms); gameplay lists the real pinch/chirality actions too. The gestures always worked — only the on-screen guide was wrong.

## Install
SideStore/AltStore: the source auto-updates to this version. Or sideload the IPAs below — dev-signed, so SideStore re-signs on install.

Online multiplayer, plus a big round of visionOS and iOS polish.

## New
- **Online Multi Battle** — up to 5 players over WebRTC, on the official `api.apotris.com` server. Verified cross-country on real iPhone + Vision Pro.

## Fixed / improved
- **visionOS gamepad** now works — the controller reaches GCController instead of being turned into a gaze pointer. Left stick doubles as the d-pad.
- **visionOS window** — the move/resize handles are back, and the window is resizable.
- **iOS touch** — tighter d-pad so a left/right press no longer misfires a destructive drop.
- **Pause menu** Restart/Quit work on touch, gaze, and controller.
- **Audio** revives after closing and reopening the visionOS window.
- Bigger on-screen buttons; a gesture reference table in Settings.

## Install
SideStore/AltStore: add the source (auto-updates), or sideload the IPAs below. Dev-signed — SideStore re-signs on install.

**Apotris for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro** — the first release.

A native port of [Apotris](https://apotris.com) by akouzoukos: the game's own
engine rebuilt for Apple platforms and presented through Metal (no emulator).

**Install:** add the SideStore source in the [README](../../#install) — Apotris
auto-updates from there. Or grab the `.ipa` below and sideload it directly
(iOS/iPad via SideStore/AltStore/Sideloadly; Vision Pro via SideStore installed
with [iloader](https://github.com/rebelancap/iloader/releases#release-visionos)).

**Highlights**
- All offline modes: Marathon, Sprint, Dig, Ultra, Blitz, Combo, Zen, Master, Death, Training, and CPU battle
- Gesture controls (drag/flick/tap), an optional GB-button overlay with haptics, full game-controller and keyboard support
- Display filters: Sharp / LCD / CRT
- Apple Vision Pro: a crisp, free-resizing window with chirality pinch controls and a native control ornament

Online multiplayer isn't in this build yet.

Licensed AGPL-3.0, matching upstream Apotris.
